How we keep your account secure

Real-time transaction monitoring, with sanctions and wallet screening.

Passkeys, PIN and authenticator app, with extra checks on sensitive actions.

Personal data and documents are never sent to the AI model.

Crypto is held on institutional-grade custody with MPC keys, so no single private key ever exists in full, and outgoing transfers above a set limit need dual approval.

Identity verification with document and liveness checks.

Kai is a unified financial platform. Coin Bridge AG is a member of VQF (VQF member no. 10127), a Swiss self-regulatory organization (SRO) supervised by FINMA.

One Kai platform, on web and mobile.

Kai platform brings fiat accounts, crypto, stablecoins and cards into one account, on the web and in the Kai app for iOS and Android. Use the same account and the same balance on your laptop or your phone, and pick up where you left off. Coming soon on both.

Questions about Kai platform.

  • Kai platform (kai.xyz) is one account for fiat, crypto and cards, with one balance to spend, trade and move. It is for individuals and for businesses.

  • Kai gives you personal IBANs in EUR and GBP to receive, hold and send money, with USD and ILS coming next. You can also hold, transfer and trade major crypto and stablecoins in the same Kai account.

  • Stocks are coming next on Kai platform. You will be able to invest in US-listed stocks from the same account.

  • Kai gives you prepaid virtual cards to spend online and in store. Each card is funded from your Kai balances.

  • Kai AI answers questions about your money, by text or voice, and prepares payments and moves for you. Nothing moves until you approve, your personal data and documents are never sent to the AI model, and Kai AI does not give investment advice.

  • Press “Become the First” to be the first to know when Kai platform opens in your country. Companies can join the business waitlist for Kai Business.
